main_measure.name: mean excess 5-bar forward return on long bars (fwd 5-bar return minus coin's mean 5-bar return), pooled, before costs

statistic.name: t of the mean on non-overlapping 5-bar blocks

main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 and t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 and t <= -2 (t on non-overlapping 5-bar blocks); otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 5-bar return on forecast across long bars (should be > 0)

decided_by: The result meets neither the confirm nor the reject rule (t between -2 and 2 or sign disagreeing), so it is inconclusive.
reading: The coin's mean 5-bar return is taken over all its bars' forward returns in all windows; the mean excess is over all long bars while the t uses only long bars on each window's 0,5,10,... grid; the supporting slope is reported but not part of the decision since the confirm/reject rules do not mention it.
